description: Elisabeth and Franz face the demands of succession, family and imperial politics as personal losses and growing unrest test both their marriage and Elisabeth’s place within the monarchy.

s02e01.description: The need for an heir places renewed pressure on Elisabeth and Franz as succession, family expectations and imperial responsibility collide.

s02e02.description: Elisabeth is shaken by a troubling dream while the court’s demands and the couple’s unresolved losses place fresh strain on the marriage.

s02e03.description: A letter from Elisabeth becomes entangled with court politics as private grief and public duty pull the imperial family in opposing directions.

s02e04.description: Elisabeth seeks a way forward under mounting pressure while political maneuvering and personal loyalties become increasingly difficult to separate.

s02e05.description: The imperial family confronts painful truths and deepening conflict as Elisabeth searches for strength beyond the restrictions of court life.

s02e06.description: Elisabeth and Franz face the consequences of the season’s political and personal crises, forcing difficult choices about family, duty and their future.
